redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. No substantial overlaps remain: D1 (overall results), D2 (balance sheet), D3 (key performance drivers), D4 (fibreboard segment), D5 (real estate), D6 (cash flow), D7 (energy investment), D8 (personnel) each address distinct material facts without evaluative overlap.

key_information_units.information: Consolidated net revenue increased 7.3% to €1.86 million in Q1 2026 (Q1 2025: €1.74 million), with consolidated EBITDA at negative €395 thousand (margin negative 21%) and net loss of €570 thousand; basic/diluted EPS was negative €0.07.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Nordic Fibreboard AS consolidated net revenue in Q1 2026 was €1.86 million, representing a 7.3% increase compared to Q1 2025. Consolidated EBITDA in Q1 2026 was negative €395 thousand, with an EBITDA margin of negative 21%. The Group's consolidated net loss for Q1 2026 was €570 thousand.' Financial Highlights table confirms figures. Note 12 shows basic/diluted EPS of (€0.07).

key_information_units.information: Total assets increased to €9.694 million as of 31 March 2026 (31 December 2025: €9.323 million); total liabilities were €5.802 million (payables and prepayments €2.3 million, borrowings €3.3 million) with equity decreasing to €3.892 million (31 December 2025: €4.462 million).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated Statements of Financial Positions: 'As of 31.03.2026 the total assets of Nordic Fibreboard AS were €9.7 million... liabilities €5.8 million... equity €3.9 million.' Comparative figures from 31.12.2025 column. Note 9 shows payables and prepayments of €2,348 thousand as of 31.03.2026; Note 8 shows borrowings of €3,320 thousand as of 31.03.2026.

key_information_units.information: Q1 2026 results were negatively impacted by a scheduled factory shutdown in early January for the new boiler house transition and a sharp increase in gas prices in February 2026; the boiler house start-up and calibration took approximately two months.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The results for Q1 2026 were negatively impacted by the scheduled shutdown of the factory in early January in connection with the transition to the new boiler house... In late February, the US military attack on Iran caused a sharp increase in energy prices... The EBITDA for Q1 2026 was impacted by the commissioning of the new gas boiler house, the calibration and start-up of which took approximately two months.'

key_information_units.information: Fibreboard segment revenue was €1.86 million (+7.3% YoY), driven by increased orders from Finnish DIY stores (volume €855 thousand vs €614 thousand in Q1 2025); segment EBITDA was negative €321 thousand with sales split: EU €1,781 thousand, Africa €62 thousand, Asia €13 thousand.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Fibreboard Production and Sales section: 'Revenue from fibreboard sales amounted to €1.86 million in Q1 2026... improvement supported by Finnish DIY stores... order volume increased by €241 thousand.' Sales by Geographical Segments table provides regional breakdown. EBITDA figure stated in same section.

key_information_units.information: Real estate development: design works and building permits were completed for the Admirali Quarter project at Suur-Jõe 48; on 08.01.2026 a preliminary sale-purchase agreement was signed for ten properties, with the final agreement required by 30.06.2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Real Estate Management section: 'Design works... completed. Building permits have been issued... 08.01.2026 Nordic Fibreboard AS entered into a preliminary sale-purchase agreement for the sale of ten properties... final sale-purchase agreement... no later than 30.06.2026.'

key_information_units.information: Cash flow: operating activities generated net cash inflow of €13 thousand (Q1 2025: outflow €528 thousand); investing activities used net cash of €169 thousand (Q1 2025: inflow €471 thousand); financing activities provided net cash inflow of €152 thousand; closing cash and cash equivalents were €1 thousand.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows: Shows cash from operating activities €13k, investing activities (€169k), financing activities €152k, and closing balance of cash €1k for Q1 2026 with comparative Q1 2025 figures.

key_information_units.information: The Group completed an investment in modern energy solutions (boiler house upgrade) in January 2026 to improve production process reliability and energy efficiency.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Outlook section under Fibreboard Production and Sales: 'The Group has carried out an investment in modern energy solutions, aimed at improving the reliability and energy efficiency of production processes. As part of the project, the boiler system used for steam production was upgraded, with completion taking place in January 2026.'

key_information_units.information: Personnel: 57 employees as of 31 March 2026 (down from 69 at 31 March 2025); average Q1 headcount was 59; labour costs were €0.41 million including taxes (Q1 2025: €0.47 million).
key_information_units.source_evidence: People section: 'On 31 March 2026, the Group employed 57 people (31.03.2025: 69 employees). The average number of personnel was 59 people in Q1 2026... Labour costs were €0.41 million including taxes in Q1 2026 (Q1 2025: €0.47 million).'
